text:
Maya: Quick async check — final OKR milestone stitch-up for this quarter. Please reply with one line each: shipped/slipped, owner, blockers, next action. I'll roll up for the exec digest. @Noah @Alex please start.

Noah: Shipped: model routing canary + metrics hooks. Owner: Noah. Blockers: none for canary itself. Next: bump to 50% tomorrow if no error spikes.

Alex: Slipped: API batching improvement (qp-128 batching). Owner: Alex. Blockers: perf regression in edge cases causing timeouts. Next: hotfix PR and perf test run. @Jen on SRE for test infra.

Jen: Acked. Can provision a 2h perf window tomorrow 09:00-11:00 PT. Need PR link and a small data generator.

Alex: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4823 — adds batching heuristic + fallback. @Sara please review > quick CR, tests added.

Sara: Reviewing today. Note: UX strings for degraded mode needed from Product (flag copy + tooltip).

Maya: Product will provide copy by EOD. Owner: Maya. Blocking: none after copy.

Noah: Canary details: currently at 15% routing. Metrics to watch: latency_p95, token_cost, error_rate. If error_rate > 0.5% we pause. To bump: `kubectl apply -f rollout-canary-15-50.yaml` (ops runbook attached).

devops-bot: Deploy event: canary routing change applied by noah at 1765439905. Logs sent to #eng-sre.

Alex: CR ping @Sara — the fallback logic touches kv-cache eviction, watch for cache churn in perf tests.

Sara: On it. I saw a small cache churn in unit sim but need prod perf window. Will post comments on PR.

Jen: For dependencies: we need infra quota bumped for the perf window (GPUs). @Noah can you request quota?

Noah: Request sent to cloud-ops, ETA 3h. If not approved we can reduce parallelism in test harness.

DocsBot: Reminder: update runbook + rollout checklist once we finish canary bump — assigned to Noah.

Maya: Summary for exec: shipped: routing canary + metrics hooks; slipped: batching perf (owner Alex) — hotfix + perf window scheduled; blockers: cloud quota pending (Noah) + product strings (Maya) but both mitigations in progress; next actions: CR review (Sara), perf run (Jen/Noah), bump to 50% tomorrow if stable. :thumbsup:

Alex: One more ask — post-rollback steps in runbook need clear owner. Suggest: Noah owns rollback, Alex owns PR revert. Agree?

Noah: Agree. I'll own rollback coordination.

Maya: Thanks all — I'll compile and send to exec after EOD. If anything changes ping this thread.

Jen: LGTM — will confirm perf run results here tomorrow.
